description: This file is a PHP script responsible for generating the detailed view of a Contact entity in a CRM application. It sets up the presentation layer, loads necessary dependencies, retrieves contact information, manages permissions, and prepares data for the Smarty template engine to render the contact details page.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: Represents a generic CRM entity with a static method to instantiate specific entity types.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty template engine extension used specifically within the CRM for rendering views.

classes.name: VtigerWebserviceObject
classes.description: Represents web service objects in the CRM system, used for email field retrieval.

classes.name: VtigerCRMObjectMeta
classes.description: Metadata handler for CRM objects, providing access to fields such as email addresses.

classes.name: RelatedListViewSession
classes.description: Session handler for managing related list views, including addition and retrieval of related modules.

classes.name: Vtiger_Link
classes.description: Class handling links within the CRM, used to retrieve different types of module links.

methods.description: Retrieves the block layout for a module in a specified view mode.
